summary.text: KOMPENDA AS is a private limited company registered in Halden, founded 2023-03-02. KOMPENDA AS is registered to provide courses in the construction and civil engineering industry, including HSE (health, safety and environment) and management. Its statutory purpose is to act as a course provider, along with naturally related activities. It was previously named ALFANOR 23030 AS until 2023-04-25. Its main industry code is 70.200: business and other management consultancy activities. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 4 951 260 NOK and the annual result was -736 176 NOK; operating income was down from 8 115 775 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 326 300 NOK in 2024 to -736 176 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 411 896 NOK in 2024 to -495 359 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Jesper Stordal (daglig leder and styrets leder). Its verified website is kompenda.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram profiles. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
